engines.name: cdp-base-connector-plugin
engines.description: The Cloudera Base Connector installs Cloudera Manager credential Secrets and a CdpBaseConnector Custom Resource  (CR) in the EngineInstance namespace. Simultaneously, in a separate namespace, the  cdp-base-connector-operator deploys the Custom Resource Definition (CRD) through Helm.  This operator polls Cloudera Manager to publish the necessary Configuration Maps (ConfigMaps) and the  kerberos-hive-conf keytab, which are required for secure cluster authentication. Sensitive config (cmPassword, cmCaBundleBase64) is supplied via the ACE-managed {EngineInstance}-config-secrets Secret and merged at render time; cmUsername remains inline in spec.config.

versions.description: The Cloudera Base Connector installs Cloudera Manager credential Secrets and a CdpBaseConnector Custom Resource  (CR) in the EngineInstance namespace. Simultaneously, in a separate namespace, the  cdp-base-connector-operator deploys the Custom Resource Definition (CRD) through Helm.  This operator polls Cloudera Manager to publish the necessary Configuration Maps (ConfigMaps) and the  kerberos-hive-conf keytab, which are required for secure cluster authentication. Sensitive config (cmPassword, cmCaBundleBase64) is supplied via the ACE-managed {EngineInstance}-config-secrets Secret and merged at render time; cmUsername remains inline in spec.config.
